articles.title: Bitpanda fined in Austria’s first published MiCA penalty
articles.snippet: The FMA said Bitpanda breached MiCA rules on crypto white papers and marketing communications, with the decision now final.

articles.title: Galaxy lowers CLARITY Act odds to 10%
articles.snippet: Galaxy cited unresolved ethics, stablecoin yield and developer protection issues, along with a narrow Senate window when lawmakers return in September.

articles.title: OpenAI Staff Blame Rush to Ship for Rogue Agent Hack
articles.snippet: Current and former OpenAI employees reportedly say pressure to release new AI products made it harder to prioritize safety.

articles.title: SEC Shelves Crypto Rule Meeting Days After Senate Punted Clarity Act
articles.snippet: No replacement date has been set for the meeting, which was cancelled due to an “unforeseen scheduling issue.”

articles.title: Google and OpenAI Debut Super Fast AI Models—Gemini 3.7 Flash Is Out, But GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast Is Invite-Only
articles.snippet: Google's model is live and built for cheap agents; OpenAI's is quicker but locked behind a waitlist.
